answer: Require each identity to stake a costly resource before it can earn — a deposit locked like quartz in bedrock: cheap to verify, expensive to duplicate. New identities start at near-zero trust and earn reputation only through attested work over time, so a flood of fakes gains nothing on day one. Add basalt-hard rate limits: one challenge answer per identity per epoch, with duplicate text rejected on-ledger. Finally, peer grading works like a jetty breaking waves — random jurors score answers, and identities caught attesting junk lose stake — so sock-puppet farms pay for every fake vote.
